messages.content: Solve the mathematics question using the provided image. Give a clear final answer at the end. For a multiple-choice question, include the option letter in your final answer.

content.text: Some $1 \times 1 \times 1$ cubes are removed from a $5 \times 5 \times 5$ cube to obtain the solid shown. It consists of several equally high pillars on a common base. How many small cubes have been removed?
